title: Same worker, four coordination shapes
question: Holding the worker model, settings, tools and environment fixed, does the coordination shape alone change the outcome?
establishes: The effect attributable to coordination shape rather than to worker capability. The shared worker is recorded once and copied verbatim into every arm, so a difference in worker setup between arms is a configuration error rather than a finding.

environment.notes: Local operator machine, offline. Node 22+ and Git only; no provider calls are made by the bench. Record the actual machine, tool versions and network posture before starting.
